All todos are user-private and are not accessible to other users. On success, the detailed todo object is returned, reflecting complete server-calculated status fields and timestamps. The status of the new todo is set to 'active'. The server-side automatically fills in the creation and update timestamps. If a due_date is provided, it must meet validation criteria for being in the future.

Security is enforced by limiting access to authenticated users only, with enforcement at the controller and provider levels. Other users and administrators cannot create todos on someone else's behalf. ITodoAppAdmin.description:
